metadata.name: Arçelik (Beko)

financials_multi_year.source: Arçelik FY2024 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements (KAP), read 25-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY24 rev TRY 560.94bn, EBITDA margin 5.3%, FCF -TRY 11.4bn amid Whirlpool EMEA integration. FY24 adjusted EBITDA ~TRY 24-28bn range under IAS 29.

financials_multi_year.source: Arçelik FY2025 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements (KAP), read 25-Nov-26

observations.notes: FY25 rev TRY 523.93bn (-6.6% real YoY), EBITDA margin 5.9%, FCF turned positive +TRY 5.7bn, MGL-adjusted net leverage 3.74x. FY25 S&P adjusted EBITDA ~TRY 25bn (~4.8% margin); total financial debt elevated (scaled toward TRY 289bn by late 2026).

financials_multi_year.source: Arçelik 9M 2026 Unaudited Financial Statements (Nov-26) & S&P Downgrade to B, read 25-Nov-26

observations.notes: 9M26 net sales TRY 435.3bn, net loss TRY 5.77bn under TRY 36.3bn financial expenses; pursuing Dec-26 covenant waivers; S&P downgraded to B in late 2026.

debt_maturities.source: Benchmark 8.50% Sep-28 USD Eurobond XS2695038401 (alongside substantial TRY/EUR bank & syndicated loans).

verdict.stance: Underweight / Margin Squeeze, S&P Downgrade to B & Dec-26 Covenant Waiver Pursuit
verdict.summary: S&P downgraded Arçelik to 'B' in late 2026 as 9M26 net losses hit TRY 5.77bn under TRY 36.3bn financial expenses and weak European appliance demand. Management is seeking Dec-2026 covenant waivers and executing JV rationalizations (Hitachi/LG) to protect liquidity; Koç Holding parentage remains key backstop.

positives: Koç Holding flagship consumer durables subsidiary with strong domestic market share and Beko/Whirlpool European scale.
FY25 FCF turned positive (+TRY 5.7bn) on strict NWC/capex discipline.
Portfolio simplification (Hitachi/LG JV adjustments) aimed at debt paydown.
negatives: S&P downgraded to 'B' in late 2026; actively pursuing Dec-2026 covenant waivers.
Heavy financial expense burden (TRY 36.3bn in 9M26) drove TRY 5.77bn 9M net loss.
Structurally thin EBITDA margins (~5-6%) amid depressed European white-goods pricing.

background.business_overview: Major global home-appliances manufacturer (Beko, Grundig, Whirlpool EMEA) controlled by Koç Holding.
background.asset_perimeter: Manufacturing facilities across Turkey, Europe, Asia, and Africa; Whirlpool Europe & MENA integration.
background.ownership_governance: Koç Holding (~57% economic/voting control); Borsa Istanbul listed (ARCLK).

recent_drivers: Late-26: S&P downgraded Arçelik to B; pursuing Dec-26 covenant waivers after 9M26 net loss of TRY 5.77bn and TRY 36.3bn interest/fin costs.

2025A: FY25 rev TRY 523.93bn (-6.6% real YoY), EBITDA margin 5.9%, FCF turned positive +TRY 5.7bn, MGL-adjusted net leverage 3.74x. FY25 S&P adjusted EBITDA ~TRY 25bn (~4.8% margin); total financial debt elevated (scaled toward TRY 289bn by late 2026).

Quantify cash proceeds from Hitachi/LG JV restructurings earmarked for gross debt reduction.

recovery_analysis.thesis: S&P downgraded Arçelik to 'B' in late 2026 as 9M26 net losses hit TRY 5.77bn under TRY 36.3bn financial expenses and weak European appliance demand. Management is seeking Dec-2026 covenant waivers and executing JV rationalizations (Hitachi/LG) to protect liquidity; Koç Holding parentage remains key backstop. Structural recovery anchored by Turkey industrials asset perimeter and ARCLK 8.50% Sep 2028 ($400M, XS2695038401) seniority.
